description: Resource-budget baselines for the stellar-hunts contract benchmarks (issue #281). Measured by the bench_* tests in onchain/contracts/stellar_hunts/src/bench.rs and enforced by scripts/check-bench-budgets.py in CI. Raise a baseline only with a documented, justified change to the hot path; any material regression should fail the build.

submit_answer_cpu.notes: Single submit_answer call (incl. first-call player initialisation). Typical is ~200-500k; 5M is a generous ceiling.

submit_answer_mem.notes: Memory cost of a single submit_answer call. 128 KB ceiling.

ten_submit_answers_avg_cpu.notes: Average CPU cost across ten consecutive correct submit_answer calls. Should stay well under the single-call ceiling.
